questions.question: Problems occurs if we don’t implement a proper locking strategy
options: A) Dirty reads or Unrepeatable reads
questions.explanation:
All the options are correct and any of them can happen due to improper locking strategy.
Dirty reads: Reading uncommitted data from another transaction.
Phantom reads: Seeing rows that were not there before or missing rows that were there before.
Lost updates: Overwriting another transaction’s changes.
Unrepeatable reads: Reading the same row twice and getting different values.
